name: ICEPAY for WooCommerce
author: ICEPAY

sections.description:
Accept payment methods via ICEPAY in WooCommerce.

About

The ICEPAY plugin for WooCommerce.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.6 or higher
  • WooCommerce 8.7 or higher
  • PHP 8.2 or higher

How to install

WordPress installation

Wil be provided at a later date.

Setup

  1. Sign in to your WooCommerce backend.
  2. Go to WooCommerce > ICEPAY for WooCommerce.
  3. Enter your MerchantID and Secret.
  4. Confirm your settings, and click Save changes.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  6. Enable the payment methods and click Save changes.

Supported payment methods

We currently support the following payment methods:

  • iDEAL | Wero
  • Cards
  • Bancontact
  • PayPal
  • Pay by Bank
  • Online Überweisen

Support

If you need any help or have a question, feel free to email info@icepay.com

External services

This plugin connects to our API to create payments. It sends the users billing information to our services when a users places an order. Read our Terms & Conditions
& Privacy Policy for more info.
